narrative.overview: A native Windows (PyQt6) shell with a flat navigation rail, one rounded content surface, fine borders and system typography. Custom shell surfaces are neutral; native inputs retain the Windows accent color. The recording overlay is a near-black pill with a dot waveform and semantic state colors.
keyCharacteristics: Two-pane shell: rail of nine pages + one content card; hairline borders; zero shadows.
Neutral custom shell surfaces; native controls keep the system accent.
Follows the OS scheme (sheet rebuilt on ApplicationPaletteChange); input controls stay native.

rules.name: Native platform boundary
rules.body: This is QSS and QPainter, not HTML/CSS. Web component previews are deliberately omitted; DESIGN.md and the native sources document the actual components. No synthesized tonal ramps are application tokens.

dos: Preserve native inputs, keyboard navigation and system palette changes.
donts: Do not change model or backend behavior as part of visual styling.
